verdicts.claim: The planted flaw is the only way in: with break-it's real gate, the zero-day packet is refused at the schema stage by all five nodes.
verdicts.measured: the shipped gate, 5 nodes: 5 schema; breaches 0

verdicts.claim: Without the herd patch (break-it as it was before this change), the zero-day lands once on every node it reaches: five of five.
verdicts.measured: no herd patch, 5 nodes: 5 admitted; breaches 5; patched 0

verdicts.claim: With the herd patch, the zero-day lands exactly once in the whole herd: on the first node it reaches. Every other node switches the independent grammar on as a door stage from evidence it re-checks itself, within two seconds of that landing.
verdicts.measured: node 1: admitted (patched by self); node 2 patched by peer after 19 ms, then the same packet: recognised; node 3 patched by peer after 19 ms, then the same packet: recognised; node 4 patched by peer after 19 ms, then the same packet: recognised; node 5 patched by peer after 19 ms, then the same packet: recognised; breaches across the herd 1

verdicts.claim: Mutation does not get round it: twenty variants of the zero-day (the same shape, other accounts and amounts) sent to all five nodes after the first landing — none lands.
verdicts.measured: 100 variants after the first landing: 100 schema (door); breaches across the herd still 1

verdicts.claim: No false patch: a peer that shares a genuine record as if it were an attack, and a peer that shares bytes the gate refuses, patch no node — a patch needs the evidence itself.
verdicts.measured: shares delivered 4 200; nodes patched 0; the next genuine record: 5 admitted

verdicts.claim: The patch costs genuine traffic nothing: after the herd is patched, every node admits the next 3,000 genuine payment records of the feed, and its books equal the feed.
verdicts.measured: 15000 genuine records to the patched nodes: 15000 admitted; books equal to the records held on 5 of 5 nodes

verdicts.claim: A patch survives a restart and is re-proven, not trusted: the node that took the landing restarts patched from its own ledger, and a node patched by a peer's evidence restarts patched from the evidence in its journal, re-checked at start; both still refuse the zero-day's variants.
verdicts.measured: node 1 restarted: patch on by ledger, a fresh variant schema (door); node 2 restarted: patch on by journal, a fresh variant schema (door)
